description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Treasury Bonds issued in Year 2015
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of powers under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance to raise government loans through Treasury Bonds. It references specific legal authorities (Ordinance No. 07 of 1937 and subsequent amendment Acts) and contains regulatory details about bond issuance, interest rates, payment schedules, and maturity terms. While it mentions Mahinda Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance and Planning, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on the implementation of financial regulations and government borrowing mechanisms rather than personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
